description: A blue square on red, blurred by 0.05 of the layer's height -- about three pixels at this raster, so the edges of the square go soft and the middle of each colour does not move. The plate fills the raster and the clip has no transform on it, which is the case the compositor's copy path would otherwise memcpy whole: a sharp square here means blur was not consulted before the layer was copied. Frame 0 and frame 14 are both compared because the blur is a static field and must not drift over the clip.
